evidence.quote: further gradual increases in the federal funds rate will best promote these goals
The labor market has been strong, and my colleagues and I on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) expect it to remain strong.
the 12-month change should move up notably this spring as last spring's soft readings drop out of the 12-month calculation
Our path of gradual rate increases is intended to balance these two risks.
Over the next few years, the size of our balance sheet is expected to shrink significantly.
